```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message= FALSE}
# read files

sub_vec = unique(df_fix_reveal$RECORDING_SESSION_LABEL)
nsub = length(sub_vec)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message= FALSE}
# Revealed block - create dataframes for the ordinal number 
df_visits = matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = 8)
df_israeli = matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = 6)
for (s in sub_vec){
  cur_sub = df_fix_reveal[df_fix_reveal$RECORDING_SESSION_LABEL == s,]
  for (t in unique(cur_sub$TRIAL_INDEX)){
    cur_trial =  cur_sub[cur_sub$TRIAL_INDEX == t,]
    cur_german = unique(cur_trial$german_loc)
    cur_israli = unique(cur_trial$israeli_loc)
    cur_soa = unique(cur_trial$soa_reveal)
    
    visit_IA = c()
    prev_sac_amp = c()
    for (i in 1:nrow(cur_trial)){
      if(!(as.numeric(as.character(cur_trial$CURRENT_FIX_INTEREST_AREA_ID[i])) %in% visit_IA)){
        visit_IA = append(visit_IA, as.numeric(as.character(cur_trial$CURRENT_FIX_INTEREST_AREA_ID[i])))
        prev_sac_amp = append(prev_sac_amp, as.numeric(as.character(cur_trial$PREVIOUS_SAC_AMPLITUDE_manual[i])))
      }
    }
    
    if (cur_israli %in% visit_IA){
      israeli_visit = which(visit_IA==cur_israli)
      prev_sac_amp_israeli = prev_sac_amp[israeli_visit]
      look_at =TRUE
    }else{
      israeli_visit = (seq(1,5)[(length(visit_IA)+1):5])[sample(5-length(visit_IA))[1]]
      prev_sac_amp_israeli = NA
      look_at =FALSE
    }
 
    df_visits = rbind(df_visits, cbind(rep(s, length(visit_IA)),
                                       rep(t, length(visit_IA)), 
                                       visit_IA,
                                       1:length(visit_IA),
                                       prev_sac_amp,
                                       rep(cur_german,length(visit_IA)),
                                       rep(cur_israli,length(visit_IA)),
                                       rep(cur_soa,length(visit_IA))))
    
    df_israeli = rbind(df_israeli, cbind(s, t, israeli_visit, cur_soa, look_at, prev_sac_amp_israeli))
  }
}

df_visits = df_visits[-1,]
df_visits = as.data.frame(df_visits)
colnames(df_visits) = c("sub", "trial", "visit_IA", "visit_index", "prev_sac_amp", 
                        "german_IA", "israeli_IA", "soa")
df_visits$familiar = ifelse(df_visits$german_IA==df_visits$visit_IA,1,0)

df_israeli = df_israeli[-1,]
df_israeli = as.data.frame(df_israeli)
df_israeli$israeli_visit = as.numeric(as.character(df_israeli$israeli_visit))
colnames(df_israeli) = c("sub", "trial", "visit_israeli", "soa", "look_at", "prev_sac_amp")

```


```{r}
# functions 

# compute the mean proportion of serial transitions (i.e., clockwise or counterclockwise) for each participant
CreateDfManipulation = function(df_visits){
  prev_t = df_visits$trial[1]
  serial_diff_clockwise = c(NA)
  serial_diff_anticlockwise = c(NA)
  
  # examine for each trial whether the transition is clockwise or counterclockwise
  for (row in 2:nrow(df_visits)){
    cur_t = df_visits$trial[row]
    if(cur_t==prev_t){
      if(df_visits$visit_IA[row]==1 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==2 |
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==2 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==3 |
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==3 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==4 |
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==4 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==5 |
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==5 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==1){
          serial_diff_clockwise[row] = 1
      } else if (df_visits$visit_IA[row]==1 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]== 5 |
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==2 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==1 |
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==3 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==2 |
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==4 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==3|
         df_visits$visit_IA[row]==5 & df_visits$visit_IA[row-1]==4){
          serial_diff_anticlockwise[row] = 1 
      }
    } else {
      serial_diff_clockwise[row] = NA
      serial_diff_anticlockwise[row] = NA
      prev_t = cur_t
    }
  }
  
  serial_diff_anticlockwise[length(serial_diff_anticlockwise):nrow(df_visits)] = NA
  serial_diff_clockwise[length(serial_diff_clockwise):nrow(df_visits)] = NA
  
  df_visits$clock = serial_diff_clockwise
  df_visits$anticlock = serial_diff_anticlockwise
  
  # compute the seriality score for each trial
  df_serial = df_visits %>% group_by (sub, trial) %>%
    dplyr:: summarise(n_transitions = length(visit_IA)-1,
                      sum_serial = max(abs(sum(clock, na.rm = T)),
                      abs(sum(anticlock, na.rm = T))))
  df_serial = df_serial[df_serial$n_transitions>0,]
  df_serial$prop_serial = (df_serial$sum_serial/df_serial$n_transitions)
  
  # compute the mean seriality score for each participant
  df_serial_by_sub = df_serial %>% group_by(sub) %>% dplyr::summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop_serial))
  
  return(df_serial_by_sub)
}

# shuffles the order of the scanned faces
Shuffle_df = function (df_visits){
  df_visits_shuffled = df_visits
  df_visits_shuffled$visit_IA = NA
  for (s in unique(df_visits$sub)){
      for(t in unique(df_visits$trial)){
        rows_cur_t = which(df_visits$sub==s & df_visits$trial==t)
        consecuetive_values = T
        while (consecuetive_values){ # runs to make sure no consecutive visits are the same
          df_visits_shuffled$visit_IA[rows_cur_t] =
            df_visits$visit_IA[rows_cur_t][sample(length(rows_cur_t))]
          diff_visit = diff(df_visits_shuffled$visit_IA[rows_cur_t])
          if(!0 %in% diff_visit){
            consecuetive_values = F
          }
        }
    }
  }

  return(df_visits_shuffled)
}

```

```{r}

# real data
df_seriality = CreateDfManipulation(df_visits)
write.csv(df_seriality, "df_serial_German.csv")

# permutation data
n_perm = 100
all_perm = matrix(nrow = length(unique(df_visits$sub)),
                  ncol = n_perm+1)
all_perm = data.frame(all_perm)
colnames(all_perm) = c("sub", as.character(1:n_perm))
all_perm$sub = unique(df_visits$sub)

for (i in 1:n_perm){ 
  cur_df = Shuffle_df(df_visits)
  cur_df_serial = CreateDfManipulation(cur_df)
  all_perm[,i+1] = cur_df_serial$mean_prop
  print(i)
}

df_all_mean = data.frame(sub = all_perm$sub,
                         mean_score = rowMeans(all_perm[,2:ncol(all_perm)]))
write.csv(df_all_mean, "df_serial_German_parm_mean.csv")
write.csv(all_perm, "df_serial_German_parm_all.csv")
```
